mg_gbc_params.rationale: Unchanged from v1 so that v2 isolates the sampling-protocol change.

primary_paired_comparison_mg_minus_arp.definition: ARI and NMI medians are taken over blocks with at least two true classes, because single-class blocks do not test between-class recovery. Their raw sklearn metric values remain in the block-level output.

acc_bijection_accounting.explanation: Hungarian ACC cannot score more clusters than there are classes; unmatched_cluster_share is the mass the bijection discards.

relationship_to_v1.status: v1 remains frozen, valid and reportable; v2 is a replication under a refined protocol, not a correction.
changes: Block eligibility adds the label-free rule n_services >= 8.
Metrics add many-to-one ACC and the Hungarian bijection penalty.
ARI and NMI are declared undefined, not zero, on single-class blocks.
The clustering methods are unchanged, so the block-rule effect is not confounded with a method change.

method_change_considered_and_rejected.candidate: rare_density_z = 1.25 (or an absolute density-contrast guard tau >= 0.075)
method_change_considered_and_rejected.effect_on_unsw: Removes the block-12 regression; worst paired delta ARI improves from -0.0833 to -0.0018.
method_change_considered_and_rejected.why_rejected: Every setting strong enough to remove the block-12 regression also stops detecting the 25-point rare core in Synthetic-Imbalance (rare-recall 1.000 -> 0.000) and, at tau >= 0.15, Page-blocks as well. The ARI gain is MG-GBC reverting to ARP-GB on the probe designed to demonstrate the mechanism.
method_change_considered_and_rejected.alternative_tried: A corridor-valley rare-core test requiring the segment to the nearest background ball to empty out. It is too aggressive in high dimensions: Digits-Rare rare-recall 0.708 -> 0.500, Page-blocks 0.143 -> 0.000, and the UNSW rare-recall advantage disappears.
method_change_considered_and_rejected.status: Open. The density-contrast statistic does not separate a true rare core from a dense majority fragment, so a cutoff on it cannot fix block 12 without cost.
method_change_considered_and_rejected.recommended_ablation: rare_density_z = 1.0 is the largest cutoff that still detects the Synthetic-Imbalance rare core. On the v2 blocks it gives median delta ARI +0.0049, median delta ACC 0.0000, median delta rare-recall +0.0378 (sign p = 0.0074) and 19/20 non-inferiority, at a cost of Synthetic-SplitRare ARI 1.000 -> 0.991. It does not repair block 12.

relationship_to_v1.pre_registration_caveat: The eligibility statistic was selected by scoring label-free candidates against labels over all 283 v1-eligible buckets. It is therefore informed by v1 outcomes and must be reported as such; the new selection seed and the untouched v1 result are what keep the comparison honest.
